#Priestbot.Face.botFaceNeutral(instant)
???: Yes, I am in my active mode.
What? I have so many questions.
Oh. Right. Shanice told me about him.
You: Hi, I’m anon. You must be Priestbot, right?
Priestbot: Actually I’m Ecclesiasticalot FF. FF stands for First and Final, I’m a perfect creation of the holy church and I’m a priest of this diocese.
Huh.{{wi}} That something really is a priest. 
I have a few more questions to ask him.
You: Uhm, is Shanice here?
Ecclesiasticalot FF: The girl? She came over for a moment and told me she is busy today. 
You: Oh… Alright.
So Shanice is not here today, huh. I was hoping to meet her.
I guess this bot will do for today.
